sources.title: Nebius Group N.V. Form 6-K, October 22, 2026 (bridge facility)

event.title: Nebius $3.5 billion senior secured bridge facility
event.summary: Nebius and two subsidiaries signed a bridge facility with Citibank to finance GPU infrastructure and for other corporate purposes.

participants.note: Citibank, N.A. is the mandated lead arranger and lender.

amounts.label: Senior secured term loan facility
amounts.quote: The Facility Agreement provides for a senior secured term loan facility in an aggregate principal amount of $3.5 billion for the purpose of financing the buildout of the Borrowers' GPU infrastructure capacity and for other general corporate purposes.

facts.label: Interest
facts.text: Term SOFR plus a margin that starts at 2.75% a year and can rise to 3.50% a year.
facts.quote: Loans under the Facility Agreement bear interest at Term SOFR plus an applicable margin commencing at 2.75% per annum and increasing by 0.25% for each 90-day period after October 17, 2026 up to 3.50% per annum (subject to other adjustments).

facts.label: Security
facts.text: Substantially all assets of each borrower, subject to exceptions.
facts.quote: The obligations under the Facility Agreement are secured by a security interest on substantially all of each Borrower's assets
